verdict.rationale: Highnote documents collaborative authorization for real-time approve/decline decisions based on your own logic, and spend rules evaluate MCC at authorization time. That implies authorization events carry at least MCC-level context, but the evidence never describes what the authorization payload actually contains. Missing for 10: documented merchant name in auth events, enhanced merchant data, wallet/tokenization and entry-mode fields, partial-approval signals, incremental-auth signals, payload schema documentation, independent corroboration.
